objectives.text: Name five forms of energy: light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy, give an everyday use for each form of energy, and describe how electrical energy changes into light and heat at a bulb
successCriteria: I can name the five forms: light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy
I can give an everyday use for each form of energy
I can describe how electrical energy travels along the wire and changes into light and heat at the bulb
assessmentPoints: Five-forms answers in the opening activity
Everyday-use and bulb-change answers in the second and third activities

objectives.text: Explain why energy is never used up - it changes form and moves somewhere else instead of disappearing
successCriteria: I can say that energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else
I can follow the energy dot from the stored circle to the heat circle to show the same energy in a new form and a new place
assessmentPoints: Trap discussion in the fourth activity
Used-up answers in the closing practice and the exit ticket

activities.title: Energy changes form at the bulb

differentiation.support: Provide the torch-circuit picture from the animation so learners can trace the energy dot along the wire before describing the change themselves.

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to explain why a lamp stopping does not mean its energy has disappeared.
